lead: File upload, data-driven. The component only picks and drops files and shows the list; the actual upload is up to you, and progress and results come back through `files`.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Drop files or click to choose them; the demo fakes upload progress with a timer.
usage.hint: Any file; names containing “fail” fail, to show the error state

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root (`data-variant` / `data-disabled` / `data-dragging` while dragging) and the trigger area
styling.trigger: Icon, main text and hint in the trigger area
styling.list: The file list and each row; `data-status` on the row is its status
styling.item: In a row: icon, file name, size and percentage, progress bar, error reason, remove / retry buttons (`data-action`)
